title: Engenheiro de software sênior
description:
Título: Engenheiro(a) Fullstack Sênior

Resumo da vaga:

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) Fullstack Sênior que atue na construção de soluções end-to-end, contribuindo tanto no front-end quanto no back-end. Essa pessoa terá papel ativo na definição de arquitetura e na evolução da experiência do usuário, colaborando com times multidisciplinares para desenvolver aplicações escaláveis, performáticas e de alta qualidade. É uma oportunidade ideal para profissionais que gostam de atuar de forma ampla e gerar impacto em toda a stack.

Principais responsabilidades:

Atuar no desenvolvimento full-stack utilizando React, React Native, TypeScript, Node.js e NestJS, liderando a entrega de funcionalidades ponta a ponta. Projetar e implementar APIs RESTful, garantindo integração eficiente com aplicações front-end. Desenvolver interfaces responsivas, acessíveis e reutilizáveis com base em design system. Modelar e gerenciar dados em bancos de dados orientados a documentos. Escrever e manter testes unitários e de integração em toda a stack. Contribuir com pipelines de CI/CD e garantir fluxos de deploy eficientes utilizando GitHub Actions. Trabalhar em conjunto com Produto, UX e Engenharia na entrega de soluções de alto impacto. Otimizar performance e assegurar compatibilidade entre plataformas. Realizar code reviews, apoiar o desenvolvimento do time e disseminar boas práticas. Manter documentação técnica atualizada e participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e inclusivo.

Requisitos técnicos:

Experiência sólida (8+ anos) em desenvolvimento de software, atuando com front-end e back-end. Domínio de React, React Native, TypeScript, Node.js e NestJS. Experiência na construção e consumo de APIs REST e no uso de bancos de dados de documentos. Vivência com arquitetura BFF. Experiência com testes automatizados (ex: Jest) e ferramentas de CI/CD, especialmente GitHub Actions. Conhecimento em acessibilidade, performance e design responsivo.

Requisitos desejáveis:

Experiência em ambientes globais, distribuídos e multiculturais. Vivência com metodologias ágeis e práticas modernas de desenvolvimento. Perfil colaborativo, com boa comunicação e facilidade para atuar com times multidisciplinares. Mentalidade de dono, com forte capacidade de resolução de problemas.

Informações adicionais:

Inglês avançado (nível B2/C1) para comunicação diária em ambiente global.


Contrato PJ

Remuneração fixa mensal

Equipamento disponibilizado pela empresa

Descanso remunerado de 14 dias

title: BDR Enterprise
description:
BDR Enterprise

Pré-requisitos (experiência com):

·     Vendas complexas.

·     Utilização de sistemas como o Apollo, Sales Navigator e CRM.

·     Vendas high ticket para c-levels.

·     ABM, social selling e outbound marketing.

Modelo de trabalho:

·     Atuação remota e fulltime.

·     PJ (50% fixo e 50% por comissão) totalizando em média R$ 9.000,00 mensais + bônus por meta).

·     Nutrir os leads através do envio de conteúdo.

Soft skills:

·     Perfil estratégico e relacional;

·     Não ter medo de fazer ligações;

·     Priorizar qualidade ao invés de quantidade.

Sobre a Butterfly

Consultoria Boutique que atua no B2B complexo. O principal produto é o Metamorfose, método de estruturação completa para empresas.

title: Engineer Manager
description:
Remoto | Grupo SBF (Centauro & Nike Brasil (FISIA))


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engineering Manager para liderar nossas equipes de engenharia com foco em excelência técnica, impacto nos negócios e desenvolvimento de pessoas. Essa é uma posição estratégica de liderança, com responsabilidade direta sobre entregas, pessoas e processos.

Se você tem paixão por formar times de alta performance, toma decisões baseadas em dados e sabe equilibrar visão técnica e foco em pessoas, essa vaga pode ser sua próxima jornada!


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência prévia em posições de liderança à frente de mais de um contexto;
  • Histórico de entregas com impacto real (eficiência, performance, redução de custo ou aumento de satisfação);
  • Familiaridade com métricas de times de engenharia (DORA Metrics ou similares);
  • Experiência com sistemas críticos e em escala ;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, objetiva e empática ;
  • Capacidade de liderar e desenvolver times diversos , promovendo um ambiente seguro , colaborativo e de crescimento ;
  • Visão sistêmica e foco em resolver problemas complexos com inovação e senso de urgência;
  • Experiência prévia com desenvolvimento de software;
  • Conhecimento avançado em arquitetura de software, sistemas distribuídos e metodologias ágeis.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Liderar times de engenharia , garantindo entregas estratégicas com qualidade e alinhamento aos objetivos da empresa;
  • Atuar próximo a Produto, Design, Segurança e Infraestrutura para garantir sinergia e integração nas entregas;
  • Ser responsável por desenvolvimento de pessoas , feedbacks, mentoring e formação de cultura;
  • Participar de decisões técnicas relevantes , com foco em escalabilidade, confiabilidade e performance;
  • Gerenciar orçamento, riscos e priorizações , com capacidade de adaptação e liderança em momentos de crise;
  • Promover boas práticas de engenharia , cultura de experimentação e aprendizagem contínua.


✨ Diferenciais que somam pontos:

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência anterior em e-commerce ou ambientes de larga escala;
  • Participação em iniciativas de transformação organizacional ou melhoria contínua;
  • Publicações técnicas, participação em comunidades, eventos ou contribuições open source;
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de segurança (OWASP, NIST, ISO/IEC 27001) e atuação com Security Champions.


—

Se interessou?

title: Salesforce Dev
description:
The professional will be responsible for administering, configuring, and implementing solutions on the Salesforce platform, as well as performing advanced customizations and Apex development. They will also provide user support, ensure data quality, and contribute to the continuous improvement of the environment.


Responsibilities

title: Technical Delivery Team Manager
description:
Company Description

MillionLogics, a global IT solutions provider and trusted Oracle Partner, is dedicated to transforming enterprises with innovative, scalable, and future-ready solutions. Headquartered in London, UK, with a state-of-the-art development hub in Hyderabad, India, the company leverages a blend of expert business foresight and world-class technical talent. Specializing in Oracle Cloud and database technologies, MillionLogics offers a comprehensive range of services, including Data & AI, Cloud Solutions, IT Consulting, and Enterprise Applications. With a team of 45+ technology experts, MillionLogics is committed to delivering tailored, outcomes-driven solutions that help organizations thrive in the digital era. Learn more about their offerings at


Role Overview 

The Engineering Manager (EM) will be responsible for driving end-to-end delivery across multiple environments, ensuring timelines, quality, stakeholder communication, and execution discipline are maintained. This role will coordinate across PMs, QA, frontend, backend, data, and client-facing teams to ensure projects are delivered on time and with the expected quality.

The Engineering Manager will act as the central owner for delivery planning, risk management, issue escalation, resource coordination, and release readiness.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Own end-to-end delivery for assigned environments and ensure commitments are met
  • Create and manage delivery plans, timelines, trackers, and milestones
  • Align cross-functional teams (frontend, backend, QA, data, automation, PM) on priorities and dependencies
  • Track progress daily, identify delays early, and take corrective actions
  • Break down projects into phases with clear ownership and timelines
  • Manage risks, blockers, and bottlenecks; drive escalations and resolutions proactively
  • Coordinate with stakeholders and provide regular updates on progress, risks, and trade-offs
  • Ensure QA, data quality checks, automation, and documentation are complete before release
  • Conduct go/no-go reviews and ensure release readiness with all critical issues resolved
  • Track delivery metrics (timelines, defects, utilization, risks) and drive continuous improvement


Required skills

  • 8+ years of strong project and delivery management experience
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and cross-functional teams simultaneously
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Experience with delivery planning, risk management, and escalation handling
  • Strong understanding of QA, engineering, and release processes
  • Ability to drive accountability and execution across teams
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with project tracking tools such as Jira, Asana, or similar


Preferred skills

  • Experience managing SaaS, workflow, enterprise, or RL environment projects
  • Familiarity with frontend, backend, QA, automation, and data workflows
  • Experience with resource planning and capacity management
  • Understanding of delivery metrics, harness reports, and quality dashboards
  • Experience working with global or client-facing teams


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 8 hours per day with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Employment type  : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract :6 months (expected start date is next week)
  • Compensation : Competitive


How to Apply: Please send us your updated cv to with \"job ID: 72134\" as your email subject.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) ABAP
description:
VAGA ABERTA: Desenvolvedor(a) ABAP Sênior – Remoto


Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe? Com 30 anos de experiência e reconhecidos pelo GPTW pelo quinto ano consecutivo, estamos em busca de talentos para se juntarem a nós como Desenvolvedor(a) ABAP . Com matriz no Brasil e filiais em território internacional, oferecemos oportunidades para crescimento e desenvolvimento. Candidate-se agora e faça parte de uma equipe que transforma negócios e realiza sonhos!


Requisitos essenciais:


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento ABAP, com atuação comprovada no ecossistema SAP CCS / IS-U;
  • Domínio avançado de ABAP Objects (OO), incluindo relatórios, módulos de função e Enhancements (User-Exits, BAdIs e Enhancement Points);
  • Experiência em integração e processamento em massa utilizando BAPI, BDC, IDocs, RFC e criação e manutenção de serviços OData;
  • Experiência com Output Management utilizando SmartForms e Adobe Forms;
  • Conhecimento técnico nos módulos de Utilities, com foco em Billing, Invoicing e CS no SAP CCS;
  • Capacidade de realizar depuração avançada, análise de logs de erro e otimização de performance de código ABAP;
  • Habilidade para interpretar especificações funcionais e traduzi-las em especificações técnicas de alta qualidade.


Requisitos adicionais:


  • Conhecimento em SAP S/4HANA, incluindo Fiori e UI5;
  • Certificação oficial SAP na trilha ABAP;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis e ferramentas de versionamento, como gCTS;
  • Noções de configuração funcional básica no módulo IS-U;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, plataformas de geração de imagens ou automação de processos, aplicadas a: Automatização de tarefas, criação de relatórios e análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão e inovação contínua, melhoria da eficiência operacional e qualidade das entregas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e manter funcionalidades customizadas no ambiente SAP CCS seguindo as melhores práticas de codificação;
  • Implementar customizações e melhorias técnicas em processos de faturamento, medição e atendimento ao cliente no contexto de Utilities;
  • Prestar suporte técnico de nível avançado para resolução de incidentes, troubleshooting e análise de causa raiz;
  • Elaborar e manter especificações técnicas detalhadas e documentação das soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Colaborar ativamente com consultores funcionais para validar a viabilidade técnica dos requisitos de negócio;
  • Revisar e otimizar códigos existentes visando escalabilidade, performance e eficiência, especialmente em processos de processamento em massa.

Benefício indireto (valor fixo para custeio parcial do plano de saúde ou somado ao vale alimentação);

title: Risk Control Specialist (UTC+8 Night shift)
description:
About BingX

  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE


Responsibilities

  • Conduct user audits on the company's risk control platform
  • Monitor for and promptly respond to any abnormal transaction data, making judgments as necessary
  • Continually learn about the platform's rules and enhance personal and professional skills
  • Keep abreast of external competitors' changes in risk control rules and provide suggestions based on current regulations


Requirements

  • At least 1 year of working experience in risk control/transaction monitoring/customer support
  • Possess business sensitivity and awareness of risk
  • Strong psychological quality with effective communication and judgment skills
  • Strong logical thinking and data collection and analysis abilities
  • Strict adherence to professional ethics and information security and confidentiality in daily work
  • Work Schedule: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM (Brazil Time)


Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: Client Experience Account Manager
description:
Company Description

Fraud Deflect delivers next-generation chargeback protection with innovative solutions designed to recover up to 50% of transactions and prevent up to 99% of disputes. Using its proprietary FD.ID Technology, behavioral tracking, and real-time dispute monitoring, Fraud Deflect helps merchants protect revenue and foster scalable business growth. The fully automated platform integrates seamlessly with CRMs, gateways, and processors, requiring no merchant engineering. With transparent pricing, dedicated support, and proven results, Fraud Deflect simplifies chargeback management for businesses of all sizes.


Role Description

This is a contract remote role for a Client Success Representative at Fraud Deflect. We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Client Experience Account Manager who will be responsible for ensuring customer satisfaction, analyzing data to drive strategic decisions, retaining customers, building and maintaining strong relationships with clients, and delivering exceptional customer service on a daily basis.

Note: We only accept RESUMES (CVs) submitted in English.


Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver a white-glove experience for new and existing clients.
  • Set and manage clear client expectations and goals.
  • Monitor and report on client performance metrics regularly.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for improvement or service expansion.
  • Manage and resolve client issues, escalating as necessary.
  • Build and foster long-term client relationships to drive mutual growth.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance client outcomes and internal processes


Qualifications and Skills

  • Client Success Experience: At least 2 years of proven experience in Client Success, preferably in payments or a tech start-up environment.
  • Excellent Communication Skills: Proficiency in managing email and chat communications and leading client calls confidently.
  • Problem-Solving Abilities: Proactively identify and resolve client challenges with innovative solutions.
  • Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with systems such as AWS QuickSight, Jira, and Hubspot is a plus.
  • Documentation Skills: Ability to create clear and effective guides, templates, and troubleshooting materials.
  • Team Collaboration: Willingness to participate in knowledge-sharing sessions and contribute to process improvement.
  • Industry Context: Familiarity with the payments or fraud landscape is a strong plus.
  • Bilingual Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is required.


Why Join Us?

  • Competitive Pay: Compensation that matches your experience.
  • Remote-Friendly: Work from where you are most productive.
  • Fast-Paced Growth: Make a real impact in a rapidly scaling company.
  • Collaborative Team: Join a supportive environment focused on collective success.

title: Web3 & Al Investment Analyst
description:
Web3DXB is a Dubai-based investment and research platform focused on identifying and scaling high-potential opportunities at the intersection of blockchain, artificial intelligence, and next-generation digital infrastructure . We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet.

As we expand our investment activities, we are looking for a highly analytical and forward-thinking Web3 & AI Investment Analyst to join our team. This is a fully remote position (Poland-based) , offering direct exposure to early-stage deals, market research, and high-impact investment decisions across Web3 and AI.

This role is ideal for someone who lives at the edge of innovation — tracking narratives, identifying asymmetric opportunities, and translating complex trends into actionable investment insights.



What You’ll Be Doing



  • Conduct deep-dive research on Web3 and AI sectors, including protocols, startups, and emerging technologies.
  • Analyze market trends, narratives, and macro developments across crypto and AI ecosystems.
  • Evaluate investment opportunities, including token projects, early-stage startups, and infrastructure plays.
  • Build investment theses and present insights to internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and track key metrics across projects.
  • Collaborate with internal teams on strategy, deal flow, and market positioning.
  • Stay ahead of industry developments, identifying early signals and high-potential opportunities.


What We’re Looking For



  • 2–4+ years of experience in investment analysis, research, venture capital, or crypto/AI markets.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain, DeFi, tokenomics, and Web3 ecosystems.
  • Solid knowledge or strong interest in artificial intelligence and its investment landscape.
  • Exceptional analytical and research skills with the ability to synthesize complex information.
  • Experience evaluating startups, token models, or market opportunities.
  • Ability to think independently and form high-conviction investment views.
  • Fluent English with strong written communication skills.
  • High level of curiosity, ownership, and performance orientation.


Why Join Web3DXB



  • Competitive compensation: BRL 560,000 – 770,000 + performance-based bonuses.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote (Poland-based) with flexible working hours.
  • Direct investment exposure: Work on real deals and high-impact decisions.
  • High-growth environment: Operate at the intersection of Web3 and AI — two of the fastest-growing sectors globally.
  • Meritocratic culture: Your ideas and insights directly influence outcomes.
  • Long-term upside: Be part of a team shaping the future of decentralized and intelligent systems.


If you’re passionate about Web3, AI, and investing , and want to operate where innovation meets capital, we’d love to connect.

title: Media Technology Support Engineer
description:
Job Title: Media Technology Support Engineer

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Mode: Contract / FTE


Role Summary

Provide technical support for cloud-based media encoding, transcoding, and content delivery systems. Troubleshoot video, audio, and subtitle processing issues while ensuring platform

performance, quality, and reliability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support media encoding and transcoding workflows
  • Troubleshoot video, audio, subtitle, and content delivery issues
  • Work with cloud environments (AWS/Azure/Google Cloud)
  • Monitor and respond to tickets via JIRA and Slack
  • Create documentation and runbooks after RCA
  • Collaborate with engineering and operations teams


Mandatory Skills

  • Strong knowledge of video containers (MOV, MXF, MP4, MPEG-TS)
  • Understanding of codecs (H.264, H.265, ProRes, MPEG2, AAC, AC3)
  • Experience with subtitles/caption formats (SRT, TTML, SCC etc.)
  • Hands-on Linux or Windows Server experience
  • Cloud experience (AWS preferred)
  • JSON/XML editing and API usage
  • Experience in media/OTT/broadcast content supply chain


Experience

  • 3+ years in media technology, OTT, or video operations
  • Experience in cloud-based media workflows

title: CSV Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a CSV Consultant (Computerized System Validation ).


In this role you will:

  • Collaborate with IT stakeholders for conducting Regulatory Risk Assessment of quality systems, solutions and services
  • Review of validation deliverables, including Requirements Specifications (URS/FS), Test Protocols, and Final Reports.
  • Provide Quality support for the Projects and Application and Infrastructure changes
  • Support of Audit and Inspection Readiness of regulated solutions
  • Guiding IT stakeholder on Documents and Records Management
  • Providing recommendations to close the existing compliance gaps and improve the processes
  • Ensuring compliance to SOPs, policies and procedures
  • Conducting and coordinating periodic review of GxP applications
  • Conducting Access Roster review, Audit Trial review processes and finalizing review reports


We have some requirements:

  • CSV
  • R&D/Clinical ou Quality/Mfg ou ERP/SAP GxP Modules
  • FDA regulations 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Electronic Signatures, Audit Trails and Security events), 21 CFR Part 820, GxP Regulations, GAMP 5, SOX Regulations, EU Annex 11, EU Anness 22, ISO 9001, ITIL processes
  • Experience of using Document management tools such as Valgenesis, Veeva Vault etc.
  • Fluent English

title: Project Support Assistant
description:
Our client is a growing nationwide network of home service experts on a mission to bring world-class service to every American household with the utmost convenience. The company is committed to providing convenient, comprehensive, and ‌professional home services to families nationwide. They are guided by values of customer obsession, an execution-first approach, and an \"invent and simplify\" mentality.


We are currently seeking a skilled and motivated Business Support Assistant . This role will be responsible for coordinating the schedules of the field technicians, assigning service calls, and ensuring that all customer inquiries are handled promptly and efficiently.


Key Responsibilities:  

  • Receive incoming service requests via phone, email, or online portal. 
  • Dispatch field technicians to customer locations based on scheduling and geographic considerations. 
  • Monitor technician schedules and workload to optimize efficiency and response times. Communicate with customers to provide updates on technician arrival times and service status. 
  • Coordinate with other dispatchers and supervisors to ensure smooth workflow and effective resolution of service issues. 
  • Maintain accurate records of service calls, including customer information, service details, and technician assignments. 
  • Provide support and guidance to field technicians as needed to facilitate timely completion of service calls. 
  • Handle escalated customer inquiries and complaints in a professional and courteous manner. 
  • Collaborate with other departments, such as sales and operations, to address customer needs and improve service delivery processes.


Qualifications: 

  • Education in business administration or a related field is a plus. 
  • 3+ years of previous experience in a dispatching role, experience in a service-oriented industry will be an advantage.
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written. 
  • Excellent organizational abilities and attention to detail. 
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Proficiency in computer software applications, including dispatching software and Microsoft Office Suite. 
  • Flexibility to work in the PST (California) time zone.

title: Especialista em Plant Simulation (PJ)
description:
Buscamos um Especialista em Plant Simulation para liderar a criação de gêmeos digitais (Digital Twins) e modelos de simulação de eventos discretos. Você será a ponte entre a engenharia industrial e a tomada de decisão estratégica, testando cenários virtuais para otimizar o fluxo de produção, reduzir gargalos e validar novos investimentos antes que eles saiam do papel.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Modelagem e Simulação: Desenvolver modelos dinâmicos de alta complexidade utilizando o software Tecnomatix Plant Simulation.
  • Análise de Gargalos e Otimização: Analisar fluxos de materiais, capacidade de armazenamento, utilização de recursos (máquinas e operadores) e logística interna.
  • Programação SimTalk: Criar lógicas personalizadas e métodos avançados de controle utilizando a linguagem de programação nativa do software (SimTalk 2.0).
  • Validação de Cenários (What-if): Propor e testar alterações de layout, mix de produtos e novas tecnologias (como AGVs/AMRs) reportando o ROI das mudanças.
  • Integração de Dados: Conectar os modelos de simulação com bancos de dados (SQL, Oracle), planilhas e outros sistemas corporativos (ERP, MES, PLM).
  • Apresentação de Resultados: Traduzir dados técnicos de simulação em relatórios claros e dashboards para a diretoria e gerentes de planta.

Requisitos e Qualificações

O que você precisa ter (Essencial):

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (Produção, Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Controle e Automação) ou Ciência da Computação / áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida experiência prática com o Siemens Tecnomatix Plant Simulation .
  • Domínio de programação em SimTalk .
  • Conhecimento forte em Estatística aplicada à simulação (distribuições de probabilidade, validação de dados de entrada e análise de saída).
  • Visão de Processos Industriais (Lean Manufacturing, tempos e métodos, gargalos).

O que vai te destacar (Diferencial):

  • Conhecimento em outras ferramentas Siemens (Process Simulate, NX MCD, Teamcenter).
  • Experiência com linguagens de programação adicionais (Python, C++, SQL).
  • Experiência com emulação (comissionamento virtual conectando o modelo a PLCs reais).


Contratação: PJ.

title: Coordenador Financeiro / Contas a Pagar
description:
Quem somos

A Valuement , parte do Grupo Mantu , é uma consultoria internacional especialista em Source to Pay. Atuamos com clientes globais , ajudando a aumentar a eficiência, reduzir custos e melhorar a performance em contas a pagar, gestão de fornecedores e processos financeiros internos.

O Grupo Mantu , fundado em 2007, possui mais de 12.000 profissionais em 60 países, com faturamento anual de aproximadamente 1 bilhão de euros. Com expertise em transformação empresarial, tecnologia, marketing digital e gestão de talentos, o grupo oferece soluções estratégicas e inovadoras para clientes em diversos setores e regiões do mundo.


Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um Coordenador Financeiro / Contas a Pagar para atuar diretamente com nossos clientes globais , identificando oportunidades de otimização, eficiência e melhoria de processos financeiros .


Suas responsabilidades:

  • Analisar e monitorar processos de contas a pagar dos clientes, identificando inconsistências, duplicidades e oportunidades de economia
  • Colaborar com equipes de Procurement e Financeiro dos clientes para otimização de pagamentos e contratos
  • Desenvolver KPIs e dashboards para acompanhamento da performance financeira
  • Apoiar projetos de melhoria contínua e automação de processos
  • Atuar como elo entre o cliente, fornecedores e stakeholders internos da Valuement


Seu perfil

  • Experiência comprovada em contas a pagar, tesouraria ou controladoria
  • Domínio avançado de sistemas ERP (SAP, Totvs, Oracle, etc.)
  • Excel avançado (fórmulas, tabelas dinâmicas, relatórios)
  • Forte capacidade analítica e atenção a detalhes
  • Excelente comunicação para interações com clientes, fornecedores e áreas internas
  • Proatividade, autonomia e capacidade de influenciar stakeholders
  • Fluência em português; inglês é diferencial
  • Experiência em projetos de melhoria de processos financeiros e otimização de fluxos


O que oferecemos

  • Uma comunidade global com mais de 110 nacionalidades
  • Uma cultura baseada em confiança , onde 70% dos líderes-chave começaram em cargos de entrada
  • Um forte sistema de aprendizado com nossa Academia interna e mais de 250 módulos de treinamento
  • Um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, com encontros informais, atividades de team-building e eventos sociais
  • Compromisso sólido com Responsabilidade Social Corporativa (CSR) , especialmente por meio do programa WeCare Together


Se você é um profissional entusiasmado, focado em gerar impacto e deseja se juntar a uma equipe dinâmica e em rápido crescimento, adoraríamos receber sua candidatura!


Diversidade & Inclusão

A Valuement tem orgulho de ser uma empresa de oportunidades iguais . Estamos comprometidos em construir uma força de trabalho diversificada e um ambiente inclusivo. Por isso, recebemos candidaturas de todos os profissionais qualificados , independentemente de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, crenças, idade, estado civil, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica.

title: Analista de Integrações Digibee
description:
Na Conquest One, somos mais do que uma consultoria tecnológica: somos uma equipe movida pela paixão por inovação e pelo impacto positivo que geramos nos nossos clientes e colaboradores.

28 anos de história e 16x eleita uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar em tecnologia no Brasil (GPTW).

Desde 2021, também estamos presentes em Portugal!


Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com experiência em Digibee , com atuação focada em orquestração de pipelines, visão funcional da jornada de integração e suporte técnico (N1 e N2) .


✅ Requisitos

  • Experiência prática com Digibee (orquestração e pipelines).
  • Atuação em suporte técnico N1 e N2 em ambientes de integração.
  • Capacidade analítica para entendimento funcional dos fluxos, não apenas desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência com diagnóstico de incidentes, troubleshooting e causa raiz.
  • Vivência em ambientes críticos, com participação em salas de crise.

title: Supervisor(a) de vendas - Cachoeirinha (RS)
description:
Descrição da vaga

NOSSO MAIOR CRÉDITO É A CONFIANÇA DAS PESSOAS.

Somos um grande time conectado pelos mesmos valores, e para cumprirmos essa missão, acreditamos que a confiança é fundamental nessa jornada.

Queremos sempre estar junto, somando forças e experiências para oferecer o melhor atendimento aos clientes.

Aqui na help incentivamos a participação de variados públicos em nossos processos seletivos, promovendo a candidatura de pessoas negras, mulheres, LGBTQIAP+, acima dos 50 anos e PCDs. Desse modo, não enviesamos perguntas de cunho pessoal, favorecendo e tornando nosso ambiente mais inclusivo, diverso e respeitoso, buscando aumentar a pluralidade dos times.

E nossas vagas são para todos que sintam essa vontade inquietante de pertencer e compor um time único, confiante e forte que tem orgulho de dizer: #somoshelpers!

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • O Supervisor de Vendas realizará a gestão dos consultores da loja: acompanhar as vendas, dar suporte, contribuir com o desenvolvimento da equipe e garantir a entrega dos resultados;
  • Responsável por todos os processos administrativos da equipe;
  • Desenvolvimento e acompanhamento das estratégias comerciais;
  • Vendas de produtos financeiros e acionamentos junto à equipe;
  • Divulgação dos produtos;
  • Responsável pela abertura e fechamento da loja.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Necessário que o Supervisor de Vendas possua experiência com gestão de equipe de vendas de qualquer produto;
  • Necessário ter experiência com vendas e trabalhado com metas;
  • Desejável atuação com vendas de multiprodutos e experiências com vendas ativas por telefone e presenciais;
  • Perfil do Supervisor de Vendas: Proativo, resiliente, dinâmico, comunicativo, habilidade em negociação, organizado, senso de urgência, foco no cliente e nos resultados de vendas.
  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Conhecimento no Pacote Office.


Informações adicionais

Remuneração


Salário Fixo + Remuneração Variável + Bônus


Benefícios, saúde e bem-estar:


  • Plano de saúde após 90 dias com coparticipação de 30% em consultas e exames simples Telemedicina;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • help investe em você - plataforma educacional com + de 60 instituições de ensino;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Salário fixo + Comissão;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Parceria Gympass;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Psicologia Viva - Sessões de terapia online gratuita;
  • PAP - Programa de assessoria financeira, jurídica e psicológica.


Horário de trabalho do Supervisor de Vendas (vaga presencial):

  • Segunda a quinta das 08h às 18h
  • Sexta feira das 08h às 17h


E por fim, e mais importante, acreditamos no protagonismo dos nossos colaboradores, afinal, não é apenas sobre métodos, agilidade e digitalização. É sobre pessoas e o potencial que elas têm!

title: Data Analyst
description:
Role: Data Analyst

Contract Duration: 7 months

Work Type: Remote

Location: Colombia

Rate: 5,000,000 Colombian pesos per month


We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst to support business performance analysis and strategic decision-making. This role works closely with business, finance, and operations teams to analyze performance data, identify trends, and deliver insights that drive business decisions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze business and operational data to identify performance trends and improvement opportunities
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports to track KPIs and business performance
  • Conduct deep-dive and ad hoc analyses to explain trends and business drivers
  • Translate complex data into clear insights and recommendations
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support data-driven decisions


Required Experience

  • Master’s degree in Analytics, Data Science, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Business, or related quantitative field
  • 5+ years experience in Data Analysis or Business Analytics
  • Strong SQL skills
  • Experience with Python (or similar analytical language)
  • Experience building dashboards using Power BI or similar BI tools
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to communicate insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience with business or financial performance analytics (Preferred)
  • Experience with AWS or cloud data environments (Preferred)
  • Exposure to Spark / PySpark (Preferred)
  • Experience with data pipelines or orchestration tools (Preferred)

title: Sourcer Júnior/Pleno - BR
description:
Sobre a vaga


Estamos em busca de Sourcer Júnior/Pleno para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratação na AI/R Company, empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL fazem parte. Você será responsável por mapear o mercado, gerar listas qualificadas e atuar em parceria com os recrutadores, garantindo uma experiência de candidato fluida e processos mais assertivos.



Você será responsável por:


  • Atuar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção ativa de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Utilizar estratégias avançadas de sourcing;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de talentos atualizados e segmentados por senioridade, tecnologia e região;
  • Conduzir primeiros contatos com candidatos, apresentando a oportunidade e avaliando o fit inicial;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizadas as informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o(a) Tech Recruiter e a liderança para alinhar perfis e prioridades de busca;
  • Contribuir com relatórios de funil de recrutamento e métricas de conversão;
  • Apoiar ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos.



O que você precisa ter:


  • Experiência prévia como Sourcer, Talent Researcher ou Recrutador com foco em tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de busca e automação (LinkedIn Recruiter, AmazingHiring, SeekOut, HireEZ, etc.);
  • Experiência com buscas booleanas;
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com foco em relacionamento e abordagem personalizada.



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
The Role

Our client is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform built for social media managers, agencies, and brands. We are self-funded, profitable, and moving fast, which means the people here are not here to coast. Everyone on this team has a goal they are building toward and puts in the work to get there. If you are looking for a place where your effort directly shapes company growth and your own earnings, this is it.


We are looking for a sharp, disciplined Account Executive who closes deals without losing the relationship along the way. You are not just good on a call. You are the person who sends the follow-up within the hour, keeps prospects warm through a 30-day cycle, and never lets a qualified lead go cold because of a dropped ball on your end.


You will work inbound leads from our SDR team and marketing channels. Prospecting and sourcing are handled upstream. Your job is to convert.

What you'll do

  • Work exclusively with warm, SDR-qualified and inbound leads. You are not cold calling. You are closing.
  • Run structured discovery calls that uncover real pain, not surface-level answers
  • Deliver demos tailored to what you learned in discovery, not a canned deck
  • Own the full sales cycle from first call to signed contract
  • Keep every open opportunity engaged with timely, relevant follow-up
  • Send clear, concise follow-up emails after every call the same day
  • Maintain clean, accurate pipeline records in CRM at all times
  • Partner with SDRs to ensure tight handoffs and fast response on warm leads
  • Hit and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets consistently
  • Feed insights back into messaging, objection handling, and playbooks

title: Atlassian Consultant | Customer Facing Technical Expert
description:
Company Description

At Atlas Bench, we specialize in transforming teamwork through tailored solutions for Atlassian products. Our global team of experts in DevOps, ITSM, and agile methodologies delivers innovative services, including AI-driven integrations, managed licensing, and consulting. Trusted by over 1,000 clients, including Fortune 500 companies, we provide comprehensive support, from Jira and Confluence training to Asset Management in JSM. Join us in reshaping the future of collaboration and technology-enabled teamwork.


Role Description

This is a full-time hybrid role for an Atlassian Customer Facing Technical Expert, based in the Greater São Paulo Area with some flexibility for remote work. In this role, you will be responsible for delivering exceptional customer support, ensuring customer satisfaction, and resolving technical inquiries related to Atlassian products. You will also assist with analyzing client challenges, recommending tailored solutions, and providing training on Atlassian tools and best practices.


Qualifications

  • Strong Customer Support and Customer Satisfaction skills, with a focus on delivering excellent service and building client relationships
  • Effective Communication and Interpersonal skills for working with diverse stakeholders
  • Analytical Skills to assess client needs, troubleshoot issues, and recommend solutions
  • Experience with Atlassian tools (such as Jira, Confluence, and JSM) and a deep understanding of their applications
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a hybrid environment, balancing onsite and remote work
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred
  • Prior experience in a customer-facing technical role and fluency in Portuguese and English are highly beneficial

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Java Sênior
description:
Responsabilidades:

• Definir e garantir padrões de design e boas práticas de codificação;

• Projetar e implementar integrações críticas com plataformas externas (B3/CETIP, SPB/PSTI, SELIC, SAP S/4HANA);

• Automatizar processos operacionais, incluindo liquidação, conciliação financeira e contabilização;

• Garantir altíssima disponibilidade, escalabilidade e segurança das soluções tecnológicas implementadas;

• Realizar revisões de código e promover melhoria contínua na qualidade técnica das entregas;

• Colaborar ativamente com squads multidisciplinares, áreas de Risco, Produtos, Operações e Governança;

• Acompanhar implantações em produção e garantir suporte pós-deployment.

Requisitos Essenciais:

• Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas;

• Domínio profundo em Java 11+ e frameworks relacionados (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud);

• Sólida experiência com arquiteturas baseadas em microserviços e integração via APIs (REST, gRPC, SOAP);

• Conhecimento em sistemas financeiros e bancários (Matera, SPB, SELIC, B3/CETIP, SAP);

• Experiência em infraestrutura cloud (AWS: ECS, EKS, Lambda) e práticas modernas de CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI);

• Forte conhecimento em tecnologias de containerização e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);

• Vivência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, Oracle) e NoSQL (Redis);

Diferenciais:

• Conhecimento avançado em práticas e regulamentos bancários implementação e

• acompanhamento (Basileia, Compliance regulatório);

• Experiência em automatização de processos financeiros e contábeis;

• Familiaridade com soluções de observabilidade e segurança (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, OAuth2, mTLS);

• Conhecimento sólido em SAP S/4HANA FI-CO

title: Desenvolvedor Java/Kotlin/AWS Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 59460


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Experiência com: Java, Kotlin, AWS (Lambda, Step Function, S3, Cloud Watch, Api Gateway, EC2, DynamoDB, RDS, SQS, SNS), Kafka, Terraform, GITHUB, Datadog.
  • Desejável: Inteligência Artificial.
  • CLT pela BRQ, salário a combinar+ benefícios.
  • 100% remoto.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Role-Software Developer (Java/Golang, Python)

Primary Skills (Golang/Java – Expert Level)

8+ years of hands‑on backend development experience, with 5+ years working extensively with Golang in production environments.

Proven expertise in building high‑throughput, low‑latency services using Golang

Deep understanding of Goroutines, channels, concurrency patterns, and designing services that avoid contention and maximize throughput.

Strong knowledge of memory management, profiling, and performance optimization (e.g., pprof, benchmarking, tracing).

Capability to complement Golang services with Python‑based tools/scripts where needed

description:
Se você busca uma oportunidade na área de Tecnologia da Informação, tem organização, boa comunicação e vontade de crescer, essa vaga 100% remoto e CLT, pode ser para você.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida com Java e Angular.
  • Experiência com banco de dados;
  • Experiência com Cloud será um diferencial;
  • Idioma Inglês Avançado (terá inteirações internacionais).


Responsabilidades:

Esse profissional será responsável por desenvolver, evoluir e manter aplicações completas, atuando no backend com Java e no frontend com Angular, garantindo soluções escaláveis, estáveis e de alta qualidade. Também atuará na construção e consumo de APIs, integração com bancos de dados e desenvolvimento de interfaces modernas e responsivas, assegurando uma boa experiência ao usuário. Participará de todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento, da análise à sustentação das aplicações. O profissional contribuirá na identificação e correção de falhas, otimização de performance e evolução contínua dos sistemas, aplicando boas práticas de desenvolvimento e padrões de arquitetura. Buscamos alguém com perfil analítico, colaborativo e orientado à qualidade, que atue de forma proativa na construção de soluções eficientes e na melhoria contínua dos produtos e processos


O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.
  • Pacote de benefícios completo - PLR, VR, Gympass, Previdência, Convênios, etc.

title: Consultor(a) de Vendas - Cachoeirinha (RS)
description:
Descrição da vaga

NOSSO MAIOR CRÉDITO É A CONFIANÇA DAS PESSOAS.


Somos um grande time conectado pelos mesmos valores, e para cumprirmos essa missão, acreditamos que a confiança é fundamental nessa jornada.


Queremos sempre estar junto, somando forças e experiências para oferecer o melhor atendimento aos clientes.


Aqui na help incentivamos a participação de variados públicos em nossos processos seletivos, promovendo a candidatura de pessoas negras, mulheres, LGBTQIAP+, acima dos 50 anos e PCDs. Desse modo, não enviesamos perguntas de cunho pessoal, favorecendo e tornando nosso ambiente mais inclusivo, diverso e respeitoso, buscando aumentar a pluralidade dos times.


E nossas vagas são para todos que sintam essa vontade inquietante de pertencer e compor um time único, confiante e forte que tem orgulho de dizer: #somoshelpers!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • O Consultor de Vendas irá realizar telemarketing ativo para prospecção de clientes;
  • O Consultor realizará vendas de produtos financeiros como: Crédito Consignado, Cartão de Crédito, Seguros, Crédito Pessoal, Antecipação de saque aniversário FGTS e outros.
  • Cadastrar as propostas no sistema e fechamento de contratos;
  • Atuar na retenção e fidelização de clientes.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Perfil do Consultor de Vendas: Proativo, dinâmico, comunicativo, habilidade em negociação, organizado, foco no cliente e metas de vendas;
  • Desejável experiência com vendas e metas;
  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Conhecimento no Pacote Office.


Informações adicionais

Remuneração:


Salário Fixo + Remuneração Variável + Bônus Mensal


Benefícios, saúde e bem-estar:


  • Plano de saúde após 90 dias com coparticipação de 30% em consultas e exames simples Telemedicina;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • help investe em você - plataforma educacional com + de 60 instituições de ensino;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Parceria Gympass;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Programas de qualidade de vida;
  • PAP - Programa de assessoria financeira, jurídica e psicológica.


Horário de trabalho do Consultor de Vendas (vaga presencial):

  • Segunda a quinta das 08h às 18h
  • Sexta feira das 08h às 17h



E por fim, e mais importante, acreditamos no protagonismo dos nossos colaboradores, afinal, não é apenas sobre métodos, agilidade e digitalização. É sobre pessoas e o potencial que elas têm!

title: Data Analyst
description:
This is a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 13k-18k BRL/mo.


Must-Haves:

  • 2-5 years of experience in a data engineering/ analyst role
  • Experience with Python (ETL, transformations)
  • PySpark specifically (via Databricks)
  • Familiarity with pandas‑style transformations
  • Experience with SQL for database querying and management
  • Experience with Tableau
  • Strong visual storytelling
  • Ability to innovate and make dashboards genuinely usable


Nice-To-Haves:

  • Experience working with Databricks

Day to day:

A client of Insight Global is looking to hire a data analyst to join their team remotely in the LATAM region. This person will be responsible for partnering directly with business stakeholders to define KPIs, gather requirements, and deliver end to end data solutions. This person's main focus will be on enabling the business through clean data, strong analytics, and exceptional visualization. This person will not be maintaining existing pipelines, but building new ones to support the client's strategic initiatives.

Key responsibilities listed below:

  • Partner 1:1 with business stakeholders to:
  • Understand goals and initiatives
  • Define KPIs and success metrics
  • Perform end‑to‑end data work:
  • Identify and validate data sources
  • Transform data to align with business goals
  • Build net‑new ETL pipelines as needed
  • Develop dashboards and reporting in Tableau that:
  • Tell a clear story
  • Are visually polished and intuitive
  • Are suitable for senior leadership consumption
  • Create presentations and insights that support executive decision‑making
  • Operate in a project‑based environment with ownership from intake to delivery

title: Talent Manager - Independent Contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)

**Must send resume in English**



Overview:

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.


Key Responsibilities:


Relationship Management

  • Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
  • Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
  • Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
  • Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
  • Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate.



Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
  • Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
  • Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
  • Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
  • Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
  • Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
  • Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)


Technical Requirements:

  • Fully remote position
  • High-speed, stable internet connection
  • Professional-grade webcam
  • High-quality speakerphone or headset
  • Modern computer with reliable performance
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software


Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic and active listener
  • Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
  • Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
  • Patient and persistent in building relationships
  • Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals



Note: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

title: Talent Manager - Independent Contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)

**Must send resume in English**



Overview:

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.


Key Responsibilities:


Relationship Management

  • Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
  • Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
  • Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
  • Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
  • Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate.



Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
  • Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
  • Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
  • Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
  • Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
  • Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
  • Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)


Technical Requirements:

  • Fully remote position
  • High-speed, stable internet connection
  • Professional-grade webcam
  • High-quality speakerphone or headset
  • Modern computer with reliable performance
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software


Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic and active listener
  • Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
  • Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
  • Patient and persistent in building relationships
  • Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals



Note: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

title: Power BI Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Power BI Developer (DAX + Azure)

Location

Remote (Brazil / Argentina – Nearshore)

Duration

6+ Months Contract (High likelihood of extension)

Start Date

Immediate / ASAP (Only candidates with short or no notice period)

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Power BI Developer with deep expertise in DAX, data modeling, and Azure-based data platforms . This role requires hands-on experience building scalable BI solutions, working with large datasets, and enabling business stakeholders to make data-driven decisions.

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and optimize data models, dashboards, and analytics solutions in a modern cloud environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop Power BI dashboards, reports, and datasets
  • Build and optimize complex DAX measures and calculations
  • Develop robust data models (star schema, snowflake schema)
  • Work with Azure data services to ingest, transform, and model data
  • Build and maintain data pipelines and data integration workflows
  • Ensure performance tuning and optimization of BI solutions
  • Translate business requirements into scalable analytics solutions
  • Drive business adoption through impactful visualizations
  • Collaborate in an Agile environment

Must-Have Skills (Non-Negotiable)

Power BI & DAX

  • 5+ years of experience with Power BI
  • Strong expertise in DAX (advanced calculations, optimization)
  • Experience with Power BI datasets & semantic models
  • Strong data modeling experience

Azure (Critical)

  • Hands-on experience with:
  • Azure Data Factory
  • Azure SQL
  • Azure Data Lake
  • Azure Synapse (preferred)
  • Experience building data pipelines in Azure

Data & Backend

  • Strong SQL expertise
  • Experience with data transformation and cleansing
  • Understanding of data warehouse architecture

Additional Technical Skills

  • Experience with Snowflake (strong plus)
  • Knowledge of Python for data processing (preferred)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, version control

Experience Level

  • 8–15+ years in BI / Data Engineering / Analytics

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in CPG (Consumer Packaged Goods) domain
  • Exposure to Supply Chain or Finance data
  • Experience with SSAS / OLAP cubes
  • Understanding of microservices / APIs

Ideal Candidate

  • Strong hands-on developer with deep DAX expertise
  • Solid experience working in Azure data ecosystem
  • Able to work independently in a remote, fast-paced environment
  • Strong communicator with business-facing experience

title: Business Development Lead
description:
Company Description

Web3DXB is your go-to source for the latest Web3 and technology news emerging from Dubai. We provide in-depth coverage of topics like decentralized finance (DeFi) advancements and artificial intelligence (AI) innovations, showcasing Dubai's role in shaping the future of technology. Dedicated to connecting with the tech community, we offer bespoke coverage for tech businesses in the UAE. Join us in exploring the dynamic evolution of technology in the region.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Business Development Lead. The individual will be responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities, conducting market research, generating leads, and building strategic partnerships. The role involves engaging with potential clients, maintaining excellent customer relationships, and exploring growth opportunities to drive the success of Web3DXB.

  • Strong analytical skills to assess market trends and identify growth opportunities.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to engage effectively with clients and partners.
  • Proficiency in lead generation strategies and techniques.
  • Experience in market research and evaluating competitive landscapes.
  • Customer service skills with a commitment to building lasting relationships.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field is preferred.
  • Proven track record in business development or a similar role is an advantage.

title: Engineering Design Specialist
description:
Job Title: Engineering Design Specialist (Contract – Remote)

Location: Remote (Global) Permanent Remote Work

Contract Duration: 22 Weeks

Work Schedule: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Compensation: USD $15 – $35 per hour (based on experience)


About the Role

We are hiring experienced Engineering Design Specialists to work on advanced, simulation-based design challenges that support cutting-edge technology initiatives.

This is a unique opportunity to apply deep engineering expertise to create realistic, high-impact design problems involving real-world constraints, trade-offs, and system optimization.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop simulation-based engineering problems with clear constraints and performance goals
  • Create detailed problem sets including solutions, edge cases, and variations
  • Validate engineering designs using physics-based simulation tools
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine and improve design challenges
  • Ensure accuracy across calculations, assumptions, and real-world feasibility


Domain Expertise (Any One or More)

  • Electrical / Electronics Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Chemical Engineering
  • Control Systems
  • Civil / Structural Engineering
  • Aerospace Engineering
  • Robotics / Mechatronics
  • Materials / Nano Engineering
  • Systems Engineering
  • Energy / Nuclear Engineering


Required Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Engineering or Applied Sciences
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience (not just analysis)
  • Experience working with simulation tools (open-source preferred)
  • Strong programming skills (Python or similar)
  • High attention to detail and strong problem-solving ability


Preferred Skills

  • Experience creating engineering problems, coursework, or technical assessments
  • Exposure to AI/ML, simulation workflows, or automation frameworks
  • Cross-domain engineering knowledge


Work Setup & Additional Information

  • Fully remote, contract-based opportunity
  • Full-time commitment preferred
  • Selection process includes assessment and interview rounds
  • Candidates should be available to start within short notice (Immediate – 15 days preferred)

title: Immigration Paralegal (PORTUGUESE SPEAKER)
description:
Company Description

Brooks Law Firm is a trusted legal practice dedicated to serving clients in immigration, personal injury, social security disability, and workers' compensation. We are proudly committed to supporting Spanish-speaking and Brazilian Portuguese-speaking communities, and we work closely with organizations such as the Brazilian Workers Center. Our team provides expert legal guidance across a wide range of matters — including family-based green cards, deportation defense, personal injury claims, and workers' compensation — with a strong emphasis on client satisfaction, clear communication, and personalized service in multiple languages.


Role Description

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Family-Based Immigration Paralegal to join our team remotely. In this role, you will work closely with our attorneys to prepare and manage family-based immigration cases from start to finish. The ideal candidate is proactive, client-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced legal environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and file family-based immigration petitions and applications, including forms I-130, I-485, I-765, I-131, and all related supporting documents
  • Collect, review, and organize client documentation to ensure completeness and accuracy
  • Maintain and manage case files, deadlines, and follow-ups
  • Communicate with clients to provide case updates, request documents, and respond to general inquiries
  • Assist in preparing clients for USCIS interviews, including document review and guidance
  • Draft cover letters, affidavits, and other supporting materials
  • Monitor case progress and assist in responding to Requests for Evidence (RFEs)
  • Coordinate with attorneys to ensure timely filings and full compliance with immigration regulations
  • Handle all client information with the utmost confidentiality and professionalism


Qualifications

  • Prior experience in immigration law, specifically in family-based cases
  • Strong working knowledge of USCIS forms and procedures
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication abilities
  • Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
  • Bilingual in English and Portuguese is required — Portuguese speakers only

﻿

To Apply

  • To be considered for this position, all applications must be submitted by email to . Please include your resume and a brief description of your relevant experience.

title: Immigration Paralegal (PORTUGUESE SPEAKER)
description:
Company Description

Brooks Law Firm is a trusted legal practice dedicated to serving clients in immigration, personal injury, social security disability, and workers' compensation. We are proudly committed to supporting Spanish-speaking and Brazilian Portuguese-speaking communities, and we work closely with organizations such as the Brazilian Workers Center. Our team provides expert legal guidance across a wide range of matters — including family-based green cards, deportation defense, personal injury claims, and workers' compensation — with a strong emphasis on client satisfaction, clear communication, and personalized service in multiple languages.


Role Description

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Family-Based Immigration Paralegal to join our team remotely. In this role, you will work closely with our attorneys to prepare and manage family-based immigration cases from start to finish. The ideal candidate is proactive, client-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced legal environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and file family-based immigration petitions and applications, including forms I-130, I-485, I-765, I-131, and all related supporting documents
  • Collect, review, and organize client documentation to ensure completeness and accuracy
  • Maintain and manage case files, deadlines, and follow-ups
  • Communicate with clients to provide case updates, request documents, and respond to general inquiries
  • Assist in preparing clients for USCIS interviews, including document review and guidance
  • Draft cover letters, affidavits, and other supporting materials
  • Monitor case progress and assist in responding to Requests for Evidence (RFEs)
  • Coordinate with attorneys to ensure timely filings and full compliance with immigration regulations
  • Handle all client information with the utmost confidentiality and professionalism


Qualifications

  • Prior experience in immigration law, specifically in family-based cases
  • Strong working knowledge of USCIS forms and procedures
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication abilities
  • Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
  • Bilingual in English and Portuguese is required — Portuguese speakers only

title: Staff Software Engineer (Java/React)
description:
About the Company

Ambush is a people first company where talented, thoughtful individuals come together to build meaningful products and lasting partnerships. We believe the best work happens when people feel supported, trusted and empowered to bring their full abilities to the table.

Since 2015, because of our people first and long term mindset, we have grown into a partner relied on by some of the best companies in the world. We combine strong engineering, design and strategy with a growing strength in AI to help our clients see what is next and achieve bigger outcomes.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguous environments and deliver pragmatic technical solutions.
  • Availability to travel to Australia for an expected period of time of 2-3 months.

title: Lead Java Developer
description:
Title: Java Lead Developer

Location: 100% Remote(Brazil)

Job Type: Contract


Position Summary:

We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic Lead Java Developer to architect, lead,

and deliver scalable microservice-based solutions in a cloud-native environment. This role

requires deep technical expertise, strong leadership, and a proven track record in

enterprise-scale systems—preferably within the telecommunications industry.


Key Responsibilities:

• Architect and lead the development of robust Java-based microservices using Spring

Boot and related frameworks.

• Guide and mentor engineering teams, fostering best practices in software design,

testing, and DevOps.

• Lead cloud-native solution design and deployment using AWS, Kubernetes, and Docker.

• Design and implement event-driven systems using Apache Kafka and messaging

frameworks like Apache Camel.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical solutions with business goals

and customer needs.

• Drive modernization efforts, including monolith-to-microservices transformations and

legacy system integrations.

• Champion CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and observability practices.

• Lead initiatives in identity management, billing systems, and customer self-service

platforms.

• Ensure secure coding practices, performance optimization, and production readiness.

• Maintain comprehensive documentation and promote knowledge sharing across teams.


Required Qualifications:

• 8+ years of professional experience in Java development, including enterprise-scale

microservices.

• 5+ years of experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), including architecture

and deployment.

• Proven experience with Spring Boot, GraphQL, and Node.js in backend development.

• Strong background in event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka,

Camel).

• Experience leading application modernization and digital transformation projects.

• Expertise in containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes.

• Familiarity with service meshes (e.g., Istio), API gateways (e.g., Zuul, NGINX), and

OAuth2/SAML.

• Proficiency in CI/CD tools (GitLab, Jenkins), observability tools (DataDog, SumoLogic),

and distributed tracing.• Strong understanding of telecommunications systems, including identity, billing, and

device management.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.


Preferred Experience:

• Telecommunications industry experience, including work with customer identity,

billing systems, and network equipment management.

• Experience with full-stack development, including React or Angular for internal tooling.

• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and SAFE frameworks.

• Cloud-native tool development and internal platform engineering.

Thanks

Aatmesh
