title: Information Technology Support Specialist
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION


Job Title: IT Desktop Support Technician

Location address: Rodovia SP 101, Campinas-Monte Mor, Km 9, Condominio Techtown, Hortolandia, , Brazil

Requirement: 5 days a week


Local language preferred


Job Requirements

Technical Skills

  • 3–5 years of strong experience providing IT infrastructure field support, including troubleshooting hardware, software, and operating system issues while maintaining hardware warranty and security compliance.
  • Hands-on experience in installation, troubleshooting, and repair of desktops, laptops, printers, and other computer peripherals.
  • Basic understanding of enterprise LAN/WAN setups and ability to perform “smart hand” activities under instruction.
  • Ability to lift and move computer equipment up to 50 lbs.
  • Expertise in desk-side support and PC break/fix, including basic administration of Windows OS and MAC/Linux OS (preferred).
  • Working knowledge of TCP/IP networking, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and RDP.
  • Smart hand support for peripheral and networking hardware (e.G., monitors, keyboards, mice, printers, routers, switches, firewalls, racks, and panels).
  • Strong deductive reasoning and troubleshooting skills for system and network issues, including end-user network cabling.
  • Experience in repeat call analysis and developing preventive actions.
  • Experience in problem management and use of ticketing tools (ServiceNow, Remedy, etc.).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong time management skills, proactive ownership, and ability to meet deadlines.
  • Preferably holds an Associate Degree in Electronics and CompTIA A+ Certification.
  • Vendor certifications from OEMs such as Dell, Toshiba, Lenovo, or HP are a plus.

Must-Have Technical Expertise

  • Desktop imaging
  • Application installation and support
  • Microsoft Outlook troubleshooting
  • Printer-related troubleshooting
  • Conference room equipment management
  • Knowledge of ticketing tools


Non-Technical Skills

  • Strong customer management and interpersonal skills.
  • Good oral and written communication.
  • Ability to interact with customers at different levels.
  • Result-driven and passionate about work.
  • Capable of working independently or as part of a team.
  • Completes tasks effectively with minimal supervision.
  • Flexible and available to work on varied schedules.

title: Estágio Em Gestão Administrativa De Energia
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar na gestão administrativa dos contratos de energia, incluindo autoprodução, mercado livre de energia e geração distribuída das unidades da Aegea.
  • Realizar controle e conferência de consumos e custos de energia, garantindo a correta atualização das informações nos sistemas de gestão (Viridis e WebGEE).
  • Efetuar o preenchimento e acompanhamento de informações relacionadas às DEVECs e faturas das comercializadoras nos sistemas internos.
  • Apoiar na emissão de pedidos de pagamento e no processo de conferência de notas fiscais de fornecedores da área.
  • Realizar a operacionalização e acompanhamento de pagamentos relacionados às DEVECs, conforme exigências regulatórias de cada estado.
  • Apoiar no rateio e controle financeiro de encargos e garantias do mercado de energia (EER, Garantia Financeira e Liquidação Financeira).
  • Auxiliar no controle e reserva de débitos nas contas Trianon, garantindo o correto direcionamento financeiro das despesas.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Cursando Administração, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia de Controle e Automação;
  • Conhecimento básico em Excel e demais ferramentas do pacote Office;
  • Disponibilidadepara atuar em modelo híbrido na região de Indaiatuba;
  • Conhecimento emPower BI será considerado diferencial;
  • Conhecimento dosetor elétrico será considerado diferencial.

title: Especialista De Governanca De Dados
description:
Faça parte de uma das maiores empresas de serviços de TI do mundo! Aqui você transforma a sua carreira!


Por que entrar na TCS? Estamos procurando por Especialista de Governanca de dados , que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira, em modalidade CLT , Presencia em Londrina - PR.


Nessa posicao voce irá:

O profissional Especialista de Governança de Dados será responsável por desenvolver, implementar e sustentar a estratégia de governança de dados da organização. Atuando na implantação do modelo de Data Stewards, liderando engajamento, capacitação e construção de indicadores de qualidade. Também será peça-chave em iniciativas de letramento em dados e no avanço da maturidade dos dados organizacionais, garantindo que os dados se tornem um ativo estratégico para o negócio. Sua missão é garantir que os ativos de dados sejam gerenciados de forma segura, consistente e em conformidade com as políticas internas e regulamentações externas, como a LGPD. Este papel é fundamental para transformar dados em um ativo estratégico confiável, suportando a tomada de decisões e a eficiência operacional em larga escala.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento de Estruturas (Frameworks): Projetar e implementar o framework de governança de dados, incluindo políticas, padrões, processos e diretrizes.
  • Gestão de Dados Mestres (MDM): Liderar ou participar ativamente de iniciativas de MDM para garantir uma fonte única e confiável para os dados críticos da empresa (clientes, produtos, fornecedores).
  • Qualidade de Dados: Definir métricas de qualidade de dados (Data Quality), estabelecer processos de monitoramento e liderar projetos para correção e melhoria contínua dos dados.
  • Catálogo e Dicionário de Dados: Estruturar e manter o catálogo de dados corporativo, garantindo que a linhagem de dados, metadados de negócio e definições sejam claras e acessíveis.
  • Papeis e Responsabilidades: Colaborar com as áreas de negócio para definir e formalizar os papéis de Data Owners e Data Stewards, fornecendo treinamento e suporte.
  • Capacitação e Letramento em Dados: Conduzir programas de capacitação, promovendo a cultura data-driven e elevando a maturidade de dados da organização.
  • Modelo de Data Stewards: Estruturar, implementar e acompanhar o modelo de Data Stewards, promovendo engajamento, capacitação e responsabilidade nas áreas de negócio.
  • Maturidade de Dados: Avaliar o nível de maturidade organizacional em dados, definir roadmaps de evolução e acompanhar a execução, garantindo que os dados sejam ativos estratégicos.
  • Conformidade e Segurança: Assegurar que as práticas de gestão de dados estejam em conformidade com a LGPD e outras regulamentações, trabalhando em conjunto com as equipes de Segurança da Informação e Jurídico.
  • Liderança e Influência: Atuar como uma autoridade no tema, orientando equipes de projeto, arquitetos e líderes de negócio sobre as melhores práticas de governança.

Diferenciais (Nice to Have):

● Experiência no setor de atuação da empresa (ex: Financeiro, Varejo, Mineração).

● Conhecimento em ferramentas de governança em nuvem (ex: Azure Purview, GCP DataPlex, AWS Glue).

● Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) aplicadas a projetos de dados.

● Inglês avançado ou fluente.


Formação e Experiência Mínima

Superior completo e comprovado em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Obrigatório: Pelo menos uma pós-graduação, MBA ou certificação avançada na área (ex: DAMA CDMP Practitioner/Master, CIMP). Certificações de nível fundamental (Associate) não cumprem este requisito.


Experiência Profissional:

Mínimo de 9 anos de experiência de mercado, com um histórico comprovado na proposição de estratégia e implementação de programas de governança de dados em empresas de grande porte.

Estabilidade Profissional:

Estabilidade média de 3 anos nos últimos empregos registrados no histórico curricular.


Competências Técnicas (Hard Skills)

  • Domínio completo de todas as competências do nível Sênior.
  • Experiência comprovada na criação de business cases e na definição de ROI para iniciativas de governança.
  • Profundo conhecimento em arquiteturas de dados modernas e como a governança se aplica em ambientes Cloud e Big Data.
  • Liderança na implementação e gerenciamento de plataformas de MDM (multidomínio é um diferencial).
  • Capacidade de definir a estratégia de governança de ponta a ponta, alinhada aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.


Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills):

  • Comunicação Executiva: Habilidade para apresentar e defender a estratégia de governança para diretores e C-level.
  • Visão Estratégica: Capacidade de pensar a longo prazo e antecipar desafios e oportunidades em governança de dados.
  • Liderança e Mentoria: Influenciar pelo conhecimento, atuando como mentor para analistas e outros especialistas da equipe.
  • Negociação e Influência: Habilidade para construir consenso entre áreas com interesses divergentes e garantir o buy-in para as iniciativas de governança.


Certificações desejaveis

title: Energy Storage Operation And Maintenance Service Plan Engineer
description:
About Us

Contemporary Amperex Technology (USA), Inc. (CATU) is a U.S. subsidiary of Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Limited (CATL), a global leader in the research, development and manufacturing of advanced electric vehicle and energy storage batteries. Established in Michigan in 2017, CATU has played a critical role in advancing electric mobility and energy resilience in the U.S.


Our Vision

To become a globally leading innovative technology corporation, contribute meaningfully to sustainable energy solutions, and provide a platform that supports both the professional and personal growth of our employees.


Key Responsibility

1.Support EOMC sales by serving as the interface for customer and front-end SPP service solutions, identifying both explicit and implicit customer service needs, and developing effective service plans to help achieve sales targets.

2.Collaborate with service sales, delivery, legal, finance, QA, and other departments to draft service plans, terms, and corresponding OPEX costs that meet customer requirements, maximizing the success rate of bids.

3.Monitor the overall development trends of service-related products in the responsible region, and build the long-term competitiveness of service solutions, including timeliness, quality, cost, and safety.


Preferred Qualifications

1.Bachelor’s degree or above

2.Candidates with engineering or business backgrounds are preferred, and those with experience in new energy, data centers, or battery energy storage operation and maintenance are highly desirable.

3.Over 2 years of experience in the new energy or energy storage industry, with service experience;
project management experience is a plus.

4.Fluent in English, able to conduct in-depth business communication independently;
proficiency in a secondforeign language is a plus.


Work Environment & Physical Requirements

  1. Regular, predictable on-site attendance is an essential function of this role.
  2. Ability to move throughout offices, manufacturing facilities, and construction areas, including walking, standing, bending, kneeling, and climbing stairs or ladders.
  3. Ability to lift and carry materials weighing up to 25–50 pounds, with occasional heavier lifting as required, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  4. Ability to work in varied environments, including offices, industrial, and construction settings.
  5. Willingness to travel to other job sites as business needs require.
  6. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position, in accordance with applicable law.


Compensation & Benefits

  1. Competitive salary commensurate with experience and qualifications.
  2. Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage.
  3. 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
  4. Paid time off and company holidays.
  5. Professional development and growth opportunities.


Equal Employment Opportunity

CATU is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.


Employment Disclaimer

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. CATU reserves the right to modify, revise, or add job responsibilities as business needs evolve. Employment with CATU is at-will, meaning either the employee or the Company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law.


Export Control & Data Security Compliance

This position may involve access to sensitive systems or information subject to U.S. export control and data security regulations. Employment is contingent upon the employee’s ability to comply with applicable laws and company policies related to data protection and controlled information access.

As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.


Job Description

The IT Support Specialist provides advanced technical support and contributes to the reliable daily operation of the school’s technology services.

This role assists the Service Desk by resolving escalated technical issues across devices, infrastructure, classroom technology, and academic and institutional systems. The specialist ensures that students, faculty, and staff experience stable, secure, and consistent technology while contributing to documentation, configuration standards, and operational improvements. Working across IT Operations and Systems environments, this role combines strong troubleshooting capability with structured execution and technical discipline to support a dependable and well-managed technology ecosystem.


Service Desk & Tier 2 Support

Provide Tier 2 support for complex technical incidents and requests.

Diagnose and resolve issues related to devices, operating systems, cloud services, authentication, and connectivity.

Escalate infrastructure or systems-level issues appropriately.

Maintain clear documentation of troubleshooting steps and resolutions.

Ensure professional communication and timely follow-up with users.


Device Lifecycle & Endpoint Management

Prepare, configure, enroll, and maintain school-issued devices (MacOS, iOS, Windows).

Apply configuration profiles and policies via device management platforms (MDM).

Troubleshoot device performance, OS issues, application conflicts, and compliance failures.

Coordinate repairs and warranty cases with vendors.

Support printer troubleshooting and print management platform issues.

Update and manage the inventory of technology-related devices.


Infrastructure, AV & Campus Technology

Troubleshoot Wi-Fi connectivity issues, local network problems, and VOIP device incidents.

Support classroom AV systems, projection, audio equipment, and event technology.

Assist with basic network physical-layer tasks (AP swaps, port patching, cabling coordination).

Support firewall filtering and content filtering troubleshooting at user level.


Identity, Access & Systems Configuration

Configure and maintain user accounts, permissions, and role assignments across institutional platforms.

Support setup and configuration of academic and institutional systems

Assist with onboarding and offboarding processes by ensuring correct account provisioning and system access.

Troubleshoot authentication, permissions, and system configuration issues.

Investigate and resolve operational issues related to platform integrations (e.G., user synchronization).

Escalate issues when deeper platform configuration changes, system adjustments, or integration fixes are required.


Documentation & Process Discipline

Maintain technical documentation for recurring procedures and configurations.

Contribute to maintaining system and device standards.

Identify recurring support patterns and recommend practical improvements.

Support implementation of technical projects led by the IT Manager.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent practical experience
  • Intermediate English proficiency (for documentation, vendors, and global teams)
  • 3–5 years in IT support, endpoint management, or systems administration
  • Strong troubleshooting across macOS, iOS, and Windows
  • Apple device management experience (MacBooks, iPads, Apple School Manager)
  • Hands-on with MDM platforms like Microsoft Intune or Mosyle
  • Working knowledge of Google Workspace and Microsoft 365
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) — user lifecycle, permissions, authentication
  • Core networking concepts (TCP/IP, Wi-Fi, VLANs) and connectivity troubleshooting
  • Experience setting up and troubleshooting printers and print management solutions
  • Comfort with classroom AV and presentation technology
  • Organized, able to juggle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Clear communicator with non-technical users;
    strong service mindset
  • Curious, self-directed learner


Additional Information

title: Business Intelligence Specialist
description:
About the Role:


We are looking for a BI Specialist to structure, integrate and analyze data across our client entire operation , working closely with Operations, Marketing, CRM, Finance, Compliance, Product and Leadership .

This role is responsible for transforming operational and business data into actionable insights, supporting strategic decision-making, performance monitoring and continuous improvement across the organization.

The professional will help build the company’s data infrastructure, integrating multiple sources, developing reliable dashboards and establishing key metrics that support data-driven management and sustainable growth.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Integrate and structure data from multiple sources across Operations, Marketing, CRM, Finance, Compliance and external platforms
  • Build and maintain operational and executive dashboards to monitor company performance
  • Define and track key KPIs related to acquisition, activation, retention, revenue, risk and operational efficiency
  • Conduct cohort analysis, user segmentation and behavioral analysis across the user journey
  • Support leadership teams by transforming data into insights, diagnostics and action plans
  • Ensure data quality, consistency and reliability across reports and dashboards
  • Automate recurring reports and data processes whenever possible
  • Present insights clearly to leaders and global stakeholders
  • Collaborate with Product and Operations to support prioritization, optimization and impact analysis
  • Maintain documentation of metrics, dashboards and data sources


Requirements:

  • Experience working in technology-driven companies
  • Strong experience in business or operational data analysis
  • Advanced SQL for data extraction and analysis
  • Experience with BI and data visualization tools
  • Knowledge of data integration from multiple sources
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to communicate insights to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience working closely with business and operational teams
  • Advanced or fluent English
  • Availability to work onsite in Recife


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with GGR, NGR, LTV, churn, retention and campaign ROI metrics
  • Experience with cohort and funnel analysis
  • Knowledge of Google Analytics, Tag Manager or event tracking
  • Experience with data modeling and pipeline automation
  • Experience in regulated environments or compliance-driven industries


Benefits:

  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Plan (including dependents)
  • Ifood Benefits card (also paid during vacations)
  • Ifood Discount Club
  • Transportation allowance or fuel assistance option
  • Eyeglasses support (every 6 months)
  • Birthday Day Off
  • No dress code
  • Office snacks, coffee and tea
  • Childcare assistance (for children up to 6 years and 11 months)
  • Funeral assistance extended to immediate family members

title: Team Leader, B2b Sales
description:
The B2B Sales Leader is responsible for guiding their team of Sales Managers towards achieving the goals for each of the indicators pre-established by the Client, and for ensuring that their team's performance is monitored and improves through action plans, delivery control, and coaching focused on Quality and Productivity.


They are also responsible for understanding the reasons behind the team's performance, seeking market insights and opportunities for improvement within their team, regarding product knowledge and skills to be developed.


Through effective leadership and communication, they promote a positive team environment to meet client needs in a dynamic and diverse scenario. In this position, you will be the pillar of your team's performance, providing coaching, training, and continuous evaluation. If you are passionate about sales, have a talent for developing people, and are ready to lead, this is the perfect opportunity to consolidate your management career.


Requirements

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (B2).

Previous experience in the role.
